<!-- AUTOGENERATED by eng/DocsGen. Do not edit; run `dotnet run --project eng/DocsGen`. -->

A project declares its kind with `type`. The recognized values are below.

| Value | Files created |
|---|---|
| `dotnet-webapi` | `{Name}.csproj`, `Program.cs`, `appsettings.json`, `appsettings.Development.json` |
| `dotnet-classlib` | `{Name}.csproj` |
| `dotnet-console` | `{Name}.csproj`, `Program.cs` |
| `react-app` | `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `vite.config.ts`, `index.html`, `src/App.tsx`, `src/main.tsx` |
| `react-lib` | No implicit files |
| `angular-app` | `angular.json`, `package.json`, `tsconfig.json` |
| `angular-lib` | No implicit files |
| `react-native-app` | No implicit files |
| `static-site` | No implicit files |
| `python-app` | `pyproject.toml`, `__init__.py`, `main.py` |
| `python-lib` | No implicit files |
| `flask-app` | `requirements.txt`, `config.py`, `app/__init__.py` |
| `playwright-tests` | `playwright.config.ts`, `package.json`, `tsconfig.json`, `pages/`, `specs/`, `fixtures/` |
| `detox-tests` | `pages/{Name}.page.ts` |
| `custom` | No implicit files |

A type that creates no implicit files still creates the project directory and any `files` and `directories` the project declares.
